title: Freight broker dispatch communication on Mac: how to fix manual tracking and email chaos

description: Stop wasting time on manual freight broker dispatch communication. Learn how to manage driver updates, tracking, and email workflows on your Mac.
intro: Freight broker dispatch communication often feels like a constant, high-pressure game of telephone. You spend your day juggling emails, phone calls, and manual updates, all while trying to keep your margins intact.

blocks.text: The hidden cost of manual dispatch communication

When you manage dispatch via fragmented emails, you are essentially acting as a human router. Every time a driver calls for a status update, or a shipper asks where their freight is, you stop your real work to hunt for the answer. This is not just annoying. It is expensive. You pay for this in lost time, potential cargo claims, and the high stress of reactive firefighting.
Why your current dispatch workflow fails

The primary cause of communication breakdown is the lack of a single source of truth. If your tracking data lives in your head or a messy spreadsheet, nobody else can help you. When you are out of the office or on another call, your operations stall. Furthermore, the industry lacks standardized communication protocols, meaning every carrier does things differently.

items: Fragmented channels: moving between phone, text, and email creates data silos.
Manual overhead: chasing PODs and status updates consumes hours of your week.
Operational volatility: unexpected weather or breakdowns require immediate, accurate communication.
Data entry errors: re-keying zip codes or weights from emails into your TMS leads to costly mistakes.

blocks.text: Fixes for better freight broker dispatch communication

You do not need to buy expensive software to start improving your workflow today. Start by standardizing how you receive information. Use templates in Gmail or Outlook to ensure every driver knows exactly what you need, such as the BOL number, current location, and estimated time of arrival.
Create a standard email template in Gmail by going to Settings > See all settings > Advanced > Templates. This saves you from typing the same request to every carrier.
blocks.title: Use Gmail templates

blocks.text: Another fix is to move your tracking to a shared, cloud-based platform. If you use Google Sheets, ensure you are using [frozen rows](/how-to/freeze-the-top-row-in-google-sheets) to keep your column headers visible while you scroll through long lists of loads. This simple step prevents you from entering data into the wrong column during a busy dispatch shift.
How Lazur helps you manage your Mac workspace

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It helps you stay focused by answering your questions about what is on your screen. If you are lost in a complex TMS interface, just hold your shortcut keys and ask Lazur where a specific button is. It will circle the element so you do not have to hunt for it.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my TMS?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any application on your Mac, including web-based TMS platforms like Tailwind or Tai. It sees your screen and helps you navigate, but it does not click buttons or edit data for you.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to dictate notes to drivers?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold the fn key to dictate clean, formatted text directly into your email or TMS. It is a fast way to get your thoughts out of your head and into the system.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen and hears your voice while you hold the shortcut keys. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models.
